deviceD: Alerts pop up on this screen while the app is open.
appD: The app shows your alerts as phone notifications, also when it is closed.
appHow: The app asks your server for new alerts about every 15 minutes. It needs the phone to allow notifications.
appBlocked: Notifications are blocked for this app. Allow them in the phone's settings.
appServer: Your server does not support this yet. Update the server to the latest version.
appFail: Could not turn it on. Try again.
appSent: Sent. It arrives in a moment.
deniedHelp: Notifications are blocked for this app. Allow them in your browser's or computer's settings.
localHow: When the app is closed, the other ways on this page can still reach you.
pushSwitch: Alerts when the app is closed
pushD: Alerts reach this device even when the app is closed. This needs the app opened at a secure address (one that starts with https). On a phone, add the app to the home screen first.
noSupport: This browser does not support push.
needHttps: Push needs https. Open the app over your https address.
ntfyD: ntfy is a free app that shows alerts on your phone. You can run it on your own server.
tgD: Telegram is a free chat app. A small bot (an automatic chat account) you make there sends you each alert as a message.
whD: A webhook is a web address that gets each alert. Use it to send alerts to Discord, Slack, Home Assistant, n8n and similar.

t.needHttps: Push needs https and a browser that supports it
t.notReady: The app is not ready yet, try again
t.noDevice: No device is turned on yet

ntfyLabelD: The full address of your ntfy topic (the channel your phone listens to). Leave it empty if you do not use ntfy.
tgOnD: Alerts are sent to your Telegram.
tgOffD: Not set up. Fill in both boxes below and save.
tgTokenD: Telegram gives you this key when you make a bot with {'@'}BotFather.
tgChatD: Send your bot a message, then open api.telegram.org/bot…/getUpdates and copy the chat id.
whOnD: Alerts are sent to your web address.
whOffD: Not set up. Paste the address below and save.
whLabelD: The other service gives you this address.
privacy: Telegram and webhooks send the alert text, with account names and amounts, over the internet to that service. Turn them on only if you are comfortable with that.
whatsapp: WhatsApp has no free official way to message yourself. A Telegram bot or a webhook does the same job.
